cd /workspace && cat > tmp/big.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys,time,random,json,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
random.seed(77)
for A in [8,16,24]:
  toks=[f"s{i}" for i in range(A)]
  for natoms in [8,9,10]:
    pats=[[random.choice(toks) for _ in range(random.randint(8,16))] for _ in range(natoms)]
    rules=[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'endswith','path':p}} for p in pats]
    req={'services':toks,'rules':rules,'queries':[[]]}
    t=time.time()
    try:
        r=M.compile_bundle(req)
        s=json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':'))
        print(f"A={A} n={natoms} states={len(r['dfa']['accept'])} bytes={len(s)} time={time.time()-t:.2f}")
    except M.WireError as e:
        print(f"A={A} n={natoms} ERR={e.code} time={time.time()-t:.2f}")
PYEOF
